notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Casual Mode
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce a new feature for Brave Escape - [b]Casual Mode[/b]! Does your friend have trouble with platforming (or maybe you’re that friend)? This new mode is designed to make your adventure a bit smoother.

[h1]Casual Mode[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Casual difficulty, a more approachable experience with fewer spikes and more forgiving timing, ideal for players less experienced with precision platformers.
[*]You can swap between Casual and Standard difficulty at any time.
[*]Secret levels are only accessible when playing the level on Standard difficulty.
[/list]

[h1]Localization[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Chinese translation! Thank you Skyler Jiang.
[*]Added Russian & Ukrainian translation! Thank you Petro Kovaliv.
[/list]

[h1]Visual[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved the clarity of the countdown timer.
[*]Fixed order of caves in Lobby to match World Select.
[/list]

[h1]Level Changes[/h1]

[h3][spoiler]The Expanse - Finale 4[/spoiler][/h3]
[list]
[*][spoiler]Modified meteors.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[list]
[*]Added camera zone.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Date Update for Brave Escape
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We wanted to share an update on Brave Escape. After careful consideration, we’ve decided to move our release date to Q1 2025 to ensure the game is as polished as possible.

Here’s where we are right now: all 239 levels have been fully designed, and we’re finalizing the art for the last world. We’re also reviewing playtesting feedback, fixing bugs, discussing accessibility options, and finalizing the story to deliver the best experience we can.

Expect Brave Escape to be released early 2025, and we’ll let you know as soon as we finalize the exact date. Thank you for your incredible support and patience! We can’t wait to share more updates with you as we get closer to launch.

The Brave Escape Team at Hit Start Studios
